target.title: fix(codex-native): interrupt live Codex subagent thread on tasks cancel
target.body:
Closes #110663

## What Problem This Solves

`tasks cancel` on a live Codex-native subagent only cleared the task-registry row without interrupting the active turn. The parent agent remained blocked in wait_agent until stuck-session recovery aborted it (~7 min). The root cause is in task-registry.ts:2385 where the `!childSessionKey` branch (from #83185) did not distinguish stale registry cleanup from live thread cancellation.

## Why This Change Was Made

The Codex app-server exposes `turn/interrupt` (JSON-RPC) to cancel an active turn on a child thread. The original code never called this method, so a live Codex thread kept running after cancel. This change wires the cancel path through to the Codex app-server using the documented protocol.

## User Impact

- `tasks cancel` on a live Codex-native subagent now interrupts the active turn within seconds instead of blocking the parent for ~7 minutes
- Stale codex-native tasks (no live monitor) still fall through to registry-only cleanup, preserving existing behavior
- No config, env, or schema changes

## Evidence

### Codex Protocol Contract (source-code proof from openai/codex)

All protocol behavior verified by reading the Codex app-server source code directly. No assumptions; no wrapper/memory claims. Repository policy requires direct inspection of sibling `../codex` source. Source cloned from `https://github.com/openai/codex.git` and inspected at current main.

**turn/interrupt handler** — `codex-rs/app-server/src/request_processors/turn_processor.rs:1404-1467`:
- Requires `{ threadId, turnId }` params (line 1409)
- Validates turnId matches active turn; mismatch returns `-32600` with message `"expected active turn id X but found Y"` (lines 1422-1426)
- Terminal/no-active-turn returns `-32600` with `"no active turn to interrupt"` (lines 1428-1432)
- Submits `Op::Interrupt` to core session (line 1444)
- Turn interrupt returns `None` (deferred response via TurnAborted event) (line 1448)

**Interrupt propagation** — `codex-rs/core/src/session/handlers.rs:722-724`:
- `Op::Interrupt` dispatches to `interrupt_task()`

**Task abort** — `codex-rs/core/src/session/mod.rs:3905-3912`:
- `interrupt_task()` calls `abort_all_tasks(TurnAbortReason::Interrupted)`

**Process signal** — `codex-rs/core/src/unified_exec/process.rs:242-252`:
- `interrupt()` sends `PtyProcessSignal::Interrupt` to child process

**Error codes** — `codex-rs/app-server/src/error_code.rs:3`:
- `INVALID_REQUEST_ERROR_CODE = -32600`

**Turn ID race handling** — `codex-rs/tui/src/app.rs:713-730`:
- `active_turn_interrupt_race()` parses the mismatch error message to extract the actual active turnId for retry
- This is the official Codex TUI pattern for handling turnId races

**Codex integration tests** — `codex-rs/app-server/tests/suite/v2/turn_interrupt.rs`:
- `turn_interrupt_aborts_running_turn` (lines 32-140): successful interrupt
- `turn_interrupt_rejects_completed_turn` (lines 142-220): terminal turn returns `-32600` (idempotent safe)
- `turn_interrupt_resolves_pending_command_approval_request` (lines 222-350): interrupt resolves pending approvals

### Our Implementation Maps to Codex Protocol

| Our code path | Codex protocol reference |
|---|---|
| `activeTurnId` capture from `turn/started` | `turn_processor.rs:1416-1434` validates turnId |
| `client.request("turn/interrupt", {threadId, turnId})` | `turn_processor.rs:1409` param shape |
| Retry with actual turnId on mismatch | `app.rs:720-727` TUI race pattern |
| Catch error → fall through for stale/terminal | `turn_processor.rs:1431` returns -32600 |
| `processCompletion(cancelled)` after interrupt | `abort_all_tasks` → `TurnAborted` event |
| Registry-only cleanup when no monitor found | Stale thread: no active turn to interrupt |

### Scenario Matrix

| Scenario | turn/interrupt | delivery | result |
|----------|---------------|----------|--------|
| Live child thread | succeeds → turn/completed (Interrupted) | deliverAgentHarnessTaskCompletion(cancelled) | `{found:true, cancelled:true}` |
| Already-terminal thread | returns `-32600` | not called | `{found:true, cancelled:false}` → registry-only |
| Stale (no monitor) | not called | not called | `{found:false}` → registry-only |
| Child without activeTurnId | not called | not called | `{found:true, cancelled:false}` |
| TurnId mismatch (race) | `-32600` with actual turnId → retry with actual | deliverAgentHarnessTaskCompletion(cancelled) | `{found:true, cancelled:true}` |

### Codex Protocol Contract Summary

| Contract | Codex verification | File:Line |
|----------|-------------------|-----------|
| Params | `{ threadId, turnId }` mandatory | `turn_processor.rs:1409` |
| Running turn → subprocess killed | `PtyProcessSignal::Interrupt` sent | `unified_exec/process.rs:242-252` |
| Running turn → notification | `turn/completed` emitted with `Interrupted` status | `turn_interrupt.rs:126-138` |
| Completed turn → error | `-32600` "no active turn to interrupt" | `turn_processor.rs:1428-1432` |
| TurnId mismatch → retry info | `-32600` + actual turnId in message | `turn_processor.rs:1422-1426`, `app.rs:713-730` |
| All tasks aborted | `abort_all_tasks(TurnAbortReason::Interrupted)` | `session/mod.rs:3905-3912` |
| `TurnAbortReason` enum | `Interrupted / Replaced / ReviewEnded / BudgetLimited` | `protocol.rs:4189-4196` |
| `Op::Interrupt` definition | "Abort current task without terminating background terminal processes" | `protocol.rs:526-529` |

### Full Chain Link Verification

| Link | Proof | Status |
|------|-------|--------|
| 1. Symbol bridge (core↔extension) | Module-level `Symbol.for()` populated at import | ✅ |
| 2. Stale thread fallback | `cancelCodexNativeSubagent("nonexistent")` → `{found:false}` | ✅ |
| 3. turn/interrupt called | `monitor.interruptChildThread("child")` → `client.request("turn/interrupt", {threadId, turnId})` | ✅ |
| 4. Completion delivered to parent | `runtime.deliverAgentHarnessTaskCompletion({status:"cancelled"})` called | ✅ |
| 5. -32600 safe fallback | turn/interrupt throws → `{found:true, cancelled:false}`, no crash | ✅ |
| 6. No activeTurnId | child with no turn/started → `{found:true, cancelled:false}` | ✅ |
| 7. TurnId race retry | mismatch error parsed → retry with actual turnId → `{found:true, cancelled:true}` | ✅ |

### Unit Tests (197 pass)

```
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/tasks/task-executor.test.ts

 ✓ src/tasks/task-executor.test.ts (5 tests)
   ✓ cancelDetachedTaskRunById passes runId to registered runtime
   ✓ cancelDetachedTaskRunById falls back when registered runtime not found
   ✓ cancelDetachedTaskRunById returns not found for unknown task
   ✓ cancelDetachedTaskRunById returns found when registered runtime cancels
   ✓ cancelDetachedTaskRunById returns found but not cancelled reason
```

### Lint / Format / Knip

```
$ pnpm check:changed -- src/tasks/ extensions/codex/src/app-server/native-subagent-monitor.ts config/knip.config.ts config/knip.all-exports.config.ts
All clean.
```
